name: Citizenship by Registration -- Family Ties (Forms III & IV)

requirement_groups.name: Child with at least one Bahamian parent (Form III)

requirements.blocker_text: Must have at least one Bahamian parent (whether that parent is a citizen by birth, descent, naturalisation, or registration).
Application under Form III must be made after the applicant's 19th birthday.

requirement_groups.name: Legitimate child of a Bahamian mother born abroad (Form IV, minors)

requirements.blocker_text: Born legitimately outside The Bahamas to a Bahamian mother and foreign father -- this scenario does not confer automatic citizenship (see bs_citizenship_by_descent.json's notes on the gender asymmetry), so a Form IV application is required.
Form IV applies to minor children.

evidence_required.document: Proof of Bahamian parent's citizenship (however acquired)
Parents' marriage certificate (Form IV, if applicable)
Police certificate (within 6 months, covering 5 years, if 14+)

sources.title: Bahamas Immigration Department -- Pathways to Bahamian Citizenship: Form III (child with at least one Bahamian parent, naturalised or otherwise, application after 19th birthday) and Form IV (legitimate child of a Bahamian mother and foreign father born abroad, minor applicants)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Bahamas' initial build. Combines two distinct family-tie registration Forms (III and IV) into one route via two OR-groups since both share the same registration-based citizenship outcome and neither maps to automatic descent (bs_citizenship_by_descent.json) or the birth-in-territory route (bs_citizenship_by_registration_birth.json). Form IV's population overlaps with the 'children_born_abroad' PR-eligibility group in bs_permanent_residence_general.json -- the same child may in principle qualify for either PR (via that route) or citizenship (via Form IV here), which are modelled as two separate, coexisting options rather than one superseding the other, since the source does not state they are mutually exclusive.
